static_traits.name: He Wei
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友,但尚not yet分享其not够感与驾驶Anxiety;为避免驾驶,减少参加Social gatherings,朋友关系受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 配合度Good,Positive attitude;表达清晰,逻辑性强;倾向use严苛的自我评价与极端化表述(如'如果not优秀就失败');容易进行负性反刍与negate正面信息

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己极度苛责,尤其有关驾驶skill.最近倒车not慎撞到树后,我认为自己是世界上最差的司机,这一事件显著增加了我的压力与自我批评;此后每次需要开车我都会感到Anxiety并not断回放事故,觉得自己without法安全驾驶,已影响日常活动并造成痛苦;尝试过自我安慰与放松技巧,但负面想法仍持续.
basic_info.core_demands: 该事件trigger了我在When needing to drive的负面自我对话与Anxiety,影响日常生活与心理健康,因此我寻求咨询以应对这些压倒性的感受与想法.

core_beliefs: I am the worst driver in the world

special_situations.event: 倒车时not慎将黑色租赁车辆撞到树,车辆受损
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次驾驶错误就证明我很糟糕/not称职,意味着我not该再开车
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复在脑中回放事故,通过自我安慰和放松技巧试图缓解,但总体上减少或Avoids driving
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am the worst driver in the world

special_situations.event: 每次需要开车外出办理事务或参加Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要我开车,事情就会出错,我without法安全驾驶
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尽量not驾驶,回避外出以降低风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我开车会发生事故/我not能安全驾驶

special_situations.event: 在医院的绩效评估为'有优有缺'且同周考试成绩not yet达Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not在各方面都表现出色,就等于失败;如果not能快速改进,就会让团队失望并挂科
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻Anxiety地思考如何做得更好,设定更高标准,加强自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am failing at both work and school

special_situations.event: 收到正面反馈或还算not错的成绩
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面的结果not算数,只说明我仍not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极表现,只关注not足,继续苛责自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这not算好,我应该做得更好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, to be seen as competent, and to maintain a sense of safety
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败,被评价为not够好并让他人失望
defense_goal: Avoids failure and criticism by raising standards and blaming oneself
通过Avoids driving来保持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: A self that is not good enough and prone to failure(尤其作为司机/Learning者/员工)
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh evaluators and potential disappointed people (team, assessors, others)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当收到混合的绩效反馈或考试成绩not yet达Anticipation时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets feedback as overall failure, and believes she will disappoint the team (transference: seeing others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自我批评的语气,强调not足,忽略积极反馈;语言中Reinforcement'I am not good enough'与'I failed'的结论.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others or the counselor invite him to accept positive feedback and acknowledge small achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心放松标准就会失败,正面信息not可信,必须遵循严格标准
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持use'应该/必须'等语句,强调高标准与零容错,拒绝折中或对积极结果的肯定.

manifestations: 为避免驾驶而减少参加Social gatherings
Relationships with friends affected, growing distant
Driving avoidance limits daily travel and errands
在When needing to drive体验到被Anxiety束缚的without力感

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 语言中出现'如果not优秀就失败''我应该做得更好'等僵化标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 经常Self-denial与苛责,难以接纳小的成就
尚not yet向亲密朋友分享not够感与Anxiety,谨慎Suppressing expression

exception_events.target_problem: 在项目或考试后,来访者通常会迅速将not足视为全面失败,感到强烈Anxiety并进行Self-denial.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有几次她主观感觉项目或考试很糟,但最终收到的反馈或成绩却'还not错',与以往的最坏推断not同,让她意识到not必总是得出最坏结论.
exception_events.reason: Clue: in these situations, she waited and received more comprehensive feedback and real data, incorporating positive evidence into view, thereby breaking the previous negative filtering.

Work表现not yet受影响,具备稳定的专业能力
Having a few close friends who can provide potential support

灾难化与预测not yet来,认为开车必然出事
negate正面反馈,心理过滤只关注not足
Avoids driving,导致日常与社交受限并ReinforcementAnxiety

Recalling the accident of backing into a tree

target_behavior.consequence: 减少跑腿与参加Social gatherings,朋友Relationship tension,生活受影响

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-criticism and stress in work and studies
antecedent: Receiving performance feedback or exam results
Facing high standards and self-set expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: 非黑即白的完美主义信念('not优秀即失败')与外部评价的个人化
